commands.name: m267_boundary_objective_conversion
commands.command: Convert M266 accepted wrong-history rows into replay-aligned current-family boundary-outcome corpora and run objective/replay sanity.

decision_rule: M267 may not promote a checkpoint. If objective and replay sanity pass, it may admit a protected-surface-aware actor update or PPO repair design; otherwise PPO remains blocked for protected-surface redesign.
